verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents environments and secret variables, but nothing shows the product itself providing a sandbox, mock server, or isolated test environment that keeps tests away from production data. Pointing an environment at a staging backend would be a user-side arrangement, and the MCP server notes it sends real HTTP requests, so the evidence does not support this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
